issues.on_page: In Lieu of Taxes 6,290 (under Intergovernmental Revenues heading)
issues.issue: The receipt category rules list in-lieu of tax as 'other taxes' (detail 'other local taxes'). The report prints it under Intergovernmental Revenues, so state aid is defensible. The same applies to detail[6] ('other state aid').
'ambulance/rescue fees' probably fits better. The line may also include rural fire contract payments.
This is probably the public power district's in-lieu/gross-receipts payment ('other taxes') rather than a reimbursement. Review is already set. The same applies to detail[10].
The grant source isn't stated (federal, state or private). The actual is 0, so this only affects how the budget is classified.

The utility operation is run inside the General Fund (Public Utilities spending 219,173, likely funded by Charges for Services 139,140). It is recorded as governmental, as printed. Note that utility activity is mixed into the governmental totals.
